import re

def text_starta_endb(text):
    # ^ asserts start of string
    # 'a' matches literal 'a'
    # .* matches anything (zero or more times)
    # 'b$' matches literal 'b' at the end of the string
    pattern = r"^a.*b$"
    
    return bool(re.match(pattern, text))

# Test cases
assert text_starta_endb("aabbbb") == True
assert text_starta_endb("ab") == True
assert text_starta_endb("axxbxzb") == True
assert text_starta_endb("baaa") == False  # Starts with 'b'
assert text_starta_endb("aaaa") == False   # Ends with 'a', not 'b'

print("All assertions passed!")
